topic: Toji's near-kill is what pushed Gojo into Reverse Cursed Technique and the always-on Infinity
title: Toji Killed Gojo First, And Made Him Unbeatable
description: Gojo's untouchable Infinity exists because Toji Fushiguro nearly killed him in Hidden Inventory. Here's the chain from the Inverted Spear of Heaven to Reverse Cursed Technique to Hollow Purple. Did Toji make Gojo the strongest?
comment: Was Gojo's awakening earned, or did Toji just get unlucky? Pick one.

lines.text: Toji killed Gojo first, and that's why Gojo became untouchable.

shot.fallback: white haired sorcerer facing a muscular assassin

lines.text: Hear me out. This is my read, not canon.
In Hidden Inventory, Gojo switches off his Infinity inside the school barrier, because he thinks he's safe.

shot.fallback: sorcerer relaxing behind a glowing barrier

lines.text: Toji has zero cursed energy, so nothing even senses him coming.

shot.fallback: shadowy assassin sneaking up from behind

lines.text: Then he stabs Gojo's neck with the Inverted Spear of Heaven, a tool that cancels cursed techniques.

shot.search: Toji Inverted Spear of Heaven Gojo neck

lines.text: Gojo is basically dead, and his brain is wrecked from running Six Eyes and Limitless.

shot.fallback: white haired sorcerer bleeding on the ground

lines.text: Here's the detail most people forget. He only awakens Reverse Cursed Technique because he was dying.
He turns negative energy into positive, heals his own brain, and fires Hollow Purple.
People say Gojo would've won anyway. But his Infinity was off, and Toji walked straight through.

shot.fallback: assassin walking through a glowing barrier

lines.text: After that, Infinity runs on autopilot, with his brain healing nonstop.
So the one man who got past Gojo's defense is the reason it never really switches off again.
Toji killed Gojo first, and that's why...

shot.fallback: white haired sorcerer facing a muscular assassin
